concerns.text: Task T006a is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it modifies `code/config.py` which is also created/modified by T004. Running these tasks in parallel could cause a race condition on the same file, violating the producer‑before‑consumer ordering and breaking the `[P]` guarantee.

Task T006b is also marked `[P]` yet it writes to `results/resource_metrics.json`, a file that is initially written by T006b itself during earlier phases and later appended by T018. Parallel execution of T006b with any other task that accesses the same results file could lead to write conflicts, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.
